dialog.title: What is it?
dialog.title_example: e.g. Wine tasting, Yoga class, Members’ night
dialog.sign_up: Members sign up in the portal
dialog.walk_ins_off: Only members who signed up get in.
dialog.told: If the time or place changes, the members signed up get an inbox message and a push.

page.draft_note: A draft: members do not see it, and nobody can sign up or check in until you publish it.
page.nobody_signed_up: Nobody has signed up yet. Members sign up in the portal, or add them here.
page.nobody_in: Nobody has checked in yet. Start check-in when the doors open.

cancel.title: Cancel {{title}}?
cancel.effect: Members no longer see it in the portal and nobody can check in. Sign-ups and check-ins stay on the event’s page.
cancel.told: An inbox message and a push go to the members signed up ({{members}}): “{{title}} is cancelled”.
cancel.nobody: Nobody has signed up, so nobody is told.
cancel.reason_example: e.g. The forecast is storms; we will set a new date soon.

delete.title: Delete the draft {{title}}?
delete.effect: Members never saw it. This cannot be undone.

title: Events

empty.upcoming: No events coming up. Plan one: members can sign up in the portal, and you check them in at the door.
empty.past: Events that have ended show here, with who came.
empty.drafts: No drafts. An event saved as a draft stays here until you publish it.

read_only: Managers and staff allowed to manage offers create events.

picker.placeholder: Name, email, phone or member number

problem.title: Give the event a name.
problem.ends_at: The end must be after the start. For an event past midnight, tick “Ends on a later day”.
problem.too_long: An event lasts at most 14 days.
problem.location: Say where, in at most 200 characters.
problem.points: Points: a whole number from 0 to 100,000.
problem.capacity: Places: a whole number from 1 to 100,000, or leave it empty for no limit.
problem.walk_ins: With sign-up off, walk-ins must be welcome — otherwise nobody can come.

reason.member_erased: No access: this member was deleted.
reason.member_off: No access: {{name}}’s membership is switched off.
reason.expired: No access: the membership expired on {{date}}.
reason.place_off: No access: this place is switched off.
reason.tier_not_allowed_no_tier: No access: for {{tiers}} only — {{name}} has no tier.
reason.tier_not_allowed_none: No access: no tier is let in to this event.
reason.event_not_open: No access: check-in for this event is not open now.
reason.event_full: No access: the event is full.
reason.not_signed_up: No access: {{name}} did not sign up, and walk-ins are off.

outside.some: Signed up and left out: {{names}} and {{others}}.
